legal.beforeUsingDesc: Please read these terms carefully. By using the platform you agree to be bound by all the clauses listed below.
legal.termsFooterPre: For inquiries about these terms, contact
legal.ts1Content: RailOS is a technology platform for managing and organizing investment opportunities, connecting investors with companies and project owners. The platform does not conduct any direct financial transactions within it; all financial operations happen outside the platform between the parties.
legal.ts1Legal: Based on the provisions of the Iraqi Civil Code No. (40) of 1951 regarding freedom of contract and regulating relationships between parties.
legal.ts2Content: The user must be of legal age under the applicable local laws. By registering, you affirm the accuracy of your information and your agreement to the terms of use.
legal.ts2Legal: Based on the legal-capacity provisions in the Iraqi Civil Code.
legal.ts3Content: The platform only organizes operations and facilitates communication between parties; it is not responsible for investment losses or user decisions. Each user bears full responsibility for their investment decisions.
legal.ts3Legal: Based on the civil-liability provisions in the Iraqi Civil Code No. (40) of 1951.
legal.ts4Content: A 2.5% fee is charged on share-send operations — deducted in fee units only (not from the shares themselves). The recipient receives the full quantity. All platform fees are calculated in fee units with no deduction from shares.
legal.ts4Legal: Based on the contracting provisions in the Iraqi Civil Code.
legal.ts5Content: All actual financial transactions happen via bank transfer or the agreed methods outside the app. Payment is made after agreement via the in-platform chat.
legal.ts5Legal: Based on the Iraqi laws regulating financial activities and transfers.
legal.ts6Content: All platform content and its trademark are legally protected. No content may be copied or reused without prior written permission.
legal.ts6Legal: Based on the Iraqi intellectual-property rights protection law.
legal.ts7Content: The user may delete their account at any time after completing or cancelling all ongoing deals. The platform may suspend or cancel the account in case of a terms violation.
legal.ts7Legal: Based on the platform's right to protect the integrity of the investment environment.
legal.ts8Content: These terms may be updated from time to time. Users will be notified of any important updates via the app. Continuing to use the platform means you agree to the new terms.
legal.ts8Legal: Based on the principles of renewable contracts in civil law.
legal.pvBannerDesc: We are committed to protecting your personal data to the highest security standards. We won't share your data with any external party without your consent.
legal.pvFooterPre: To request any information about your data, contact
legal.ps1Content: RailOS is committed to protecting users' privacy and keeping their personal data confidential. This policy explains how data is collected, used and protected when using the RailOS platform or any of its services.
legal.ps1Legal: Based on Article (17) of the 2005 Constitution of the Republic of Iraq, which guarantees the protection of personal privacy.
legal.ps2Content: We collect: registration data (name, phone number, email). KYC verification data (ID photo, selfie). Usage data (login log, interactions, devices, approximate IP). Investment-opportunity data and activity log.
legal.ps2Legal: Based on Article (40) of Iraq's Constitution regarding the confidentiality of communications and electronic data.
legal.ps3Content: We use the data to create and manage accounts, verify user identity, protect users from fraud, improve the user experience, develop platform services, comply with legal requirements, and resolve disputes.
legal.ps3Legal: Based on the civil-liability provisions in the Iraqi Civil Code No. (40) of 1951.
legal.ps4Content: We do not sell user data to any third party. Data is shared only when: complying with laws, government-authority requests, with technical service providers to run the platform, or when necessary to protect the platform's and users' rights.
legal.ps4Legal: Based on the Iraqi laws regulating data sharing with official authorities.
legal.ps5Content: We adhere to the highest security standards: encryption of sensitive data, intrusion-protection systems, fraud-detection systems, restricted internal access, and continuous system monitoring.
legal.ps5Legal: Based on the Iraqi legislation related to protecting information systems and digital data.
legal.ps6Content: We retain user data throughout the account-usage period, or as required by local laws, or when needed for legal or security purposes.
legal.ps6Legal: Based on the Iraqi Constitution provisions related to privacy protection.
legal.ps7Content: The user has the right to: access their data, edit their data, request account deletion, withdraw consent for some processing types, and request a copy of their data.
legal.ps7Legal: Based on the personal-rights protection principles guaranteed in the Iraqi Constitution.
legal.ps8Content: The platform is not intended for those under legal age. We may remove any account discovered to belong to an underage user.
legal.ps8Legal: Based on the Iraqi laws related to protecting minors.
legal.ps9Content: RailOS does not manage funds or execute financial operations directly. The platform is limited to presenting investment opportunities and organizing communication and contracting between parties.
legal.ps9Legal: Based on the Iraqi laws regulating financial and investment activities.

guides.agSubtitle: Get to know RailOS and how to make the most of its features
guides.heroDesc: This guide will help you understand all the app features quickly — from registration to your first successful investment.
guides.heroCta: Didn't find your answer? Contact support →
guides.s_start_desc: Learn the app basics and how to begin your first investment experience
guides.s_start_a1: RailOS is a technology platform for managing and organizing investment opportunities, connecting investors with companies and project owners. It lets you trade investment shares, follow projects, and communicate with other investors in a safe, organized way.
guides.s_start_q2: How do I register on the platform?
guides.s_start_a2: Open the app and tap "Create account". Enter your phone number and full name, complete OTP verification, then finish your profile. After that you can use all the platform features.
guides.s_start_a3: Yes, registration is completely free. Only a 2% commission applies to share-send operations, and small commissions on completed deals (clearly announced before confirming any operation).
guides.s_kyc_desc: Identity-verification steps to raise the investment cap and unlock advanced features
guides.s_kyc_a1: Verification protects all users and ensures a safe, trusted investment environment. It's required to raise the transaction cap and access advanced features like exclusive auctions and investing in large projects.
guides.s_kyc_q2: What documents are required for verification?
guides.s_kyc_a2: A clear photo of the national ID or passport, and a selfie while holding the ID. Additional documents may be required for commercial accounts or large investments.
guides.s_kyc_q3: How long does verification review take?
guides.s_kyc_a3: Usually 24-72 business hours. You'll receive an instant notification of the review result, and if rejected you'll get a clear reason and a chance to reapply.
guides.s_wallet_desc: How to manage, send and receive your shares with full safety
guides.s_wallet_a1: A share (SHR) is the investment unit in a specific project within RailOS. Each share has a set price and a stake in the project, and grants you the right to the project's returns proportional to your shares of the total.
guides.s_wallet_q2: How do I send shares to another user?
guides.s_wallet_a2: From the portfolio page → "Send shares", enter the recipient's ID or scan their wallet barcode, choose the share and quantity, then confirm. The recipient receives the full quantity with no share deduction — the transfer fee is deducted only from the fee-units balance.
guides.s_wallet_a3: A feature that lets you list your shares for sale on the market instantly at a 15% discount off the current price, increasing the chance of a fast sale. Useful when you need instant liquidity. The price is set automatically by the system.
guides.s_market_desc: Learn how to buy shares, negotiate with sellers, and seize opportunities
guides.s_market_q1: How do I buy shares in a project?
guides.s_market_a1: Two options are available: (1) direct purchase from the platform at the official price, or (2) buying from investors via the exchange page. You can also request a direct buy from the platform on the project page.
guides.s_market_q2: What's the difference between system offers and investor offers?
guides.s_market_a2: System offers are added by RailOS administration and represent featured opportunities at official prices. Investor offers are shares sold by other users from their portfolios — you may find better prices or room to negotiate.
guides.s_market_a3: Yes, on the exchange page you can negotiate with the seller via the deal's private chat before completing it. You have 15 minutes from opening the deal to reach an agreement.
guides.s_projects_desc: Track your investments' performance and understand risk levels
guides.s_projects_q1: How do I follow a project or company?
guides.s_projects_a1: Open the project or company page and tap the "Follow" button. You'll find your follow list in the main menu → "Following", and you'll receive notifications on any important project update.
guides.s_projects_q2: How do I know a project's risk level?
guides.s_projects_a2: Each project has a clear rating: low (green) for stable projects, medium (yellow) for medium-risk projects, high (red) for promising but risky projects. You'll find the rating on the project details page.
guides.s_projects_a3: Three levels: Basic (up to 10M/month) for new investors, Advanced (up to 50M/month), Pro (up to 250M/month) for large investors. You're upgraded automatically based on your activity and verification.
guides.s_security_desc: How we protect your data and money with the highest security standards
guides.s_security_a1: Yes, we use SSL encryption for all data. Passwords are encrypted and protected. No employee can view your password. We adhere to the highest privacy standards per Iraqi legislation.
guides.s_security_q2: What do I do if I forget my password?
guides.s_security_a2: Tap "Forgot password" on the login page, and enter your registered phone number to receive a reset code via SMS. Follow the instructions to create a new strong password.
guides.s_security_a3: Yes, from Settings → "Delete account". You must complete or cancel all ongoing deals before deletion. Some data may be kept for legal purposes per Iraqi law.

guides.igSubtitle: Your journey from beginner to smart investor
guides.igHeroTitle: How do you invest in RailOS?
guides.igHeroDesc: This guide takes you step by step from discovering opportunities to selling and earning returns. You'll understand all the app features and how to use them to maximize your investments.
guides.igStepsSub: 6 simple steps from start to earning returns

igSteps.title: Discover opportunities
igSteps.desc: Browse available projects on the market page. Review all details: sector, available shares, price, risk level, and expected returns.
tips: Read the full project description before investing
Track the price movement on the chart

igSteps.title: Study & analyze
igSteps.desc: Examine the project's historical performance, funding ratio, number of investors, profit-distribution mechanism, and the company's ratings. All this info is on the project details page.
tips: Check the completion ratio before buying
Compare projects in the same sector

igSteps.title: Buy with confidence
igSteps.desc: Tap "Buy shares" and choose between a direct purchase from the platform or buying from other investors. Set the number of shares and complete the deal with one tap.
tips: Start with small amounts on your first investment

igSteps.title: Track your portfolio
igSteps.desc: From the portfolio page, see all your shares in one place. Track your investments' value in real time, and view expected returns and realized profits.
tips: Check your portfolio at least once weekly
Keep a record of every completed deal

igSteps.title: Sell whenever you want
igSteps.desc: When you want to sell your shares, go to the exchange page and create a sell listing, or use Quick Sell for instant liquidity at a 15% discount. You control the timing.
tips: Pick the right time to sell — when the price rises

igSteps.title: Take part in auctions
igSteps.desc: Auctions are a chance to get shares at reduced prices. Enter the auctions page, pick an auction, and place your bid. If you win, you get the shares below market price.
tips: Set an upper limit for your bid and don't exceed it
Watch the time remaining in the auction
Start with small auctions to learn

guides.igFlatFeeTitle: A uniform commission for all levels
guides.igFlatFeePost: commission on every successful deal regardless of the investor's level. There are no discounts or fee differences between levels. Upgrading gives you higher limits and exclusive perks — not commission discounts.
guides.igUpgradeTitle: ⬆️ How do you move up between levels?
guides.igUpgradeSub: An automatic upgrade system that rewards activity and protects the platform
guides.igAutoUpDesc: When you meet the next level's conditions, the system upgrades you automatically within 24 hours. You'll receive an instant notification and gain all the new perks immediately.
igUp2: Pro KYC (proof of income + commercial register)
guides.igCriteriaPre: The new upgrade system relies on
guides.igDownDesc: To maintain platform activity and fair upgrades, the system applies a periodic review:
igDown: Downgrade happens when upgrade criteria drop (lost disputes, reports, low rating, low success rate)
If lost disputes exceed the current level's allowance ← automatic downgrade
If the rating drops below the minimum (4.0/4.5/4.8 by level) ← automatic downgrade
You'll receive a warning notification when approaching downgrade thresholds
Restoring the previous level is possible as soon as all conditions are met again
In exceptional cases, the admin can apply a Manual Override and lock the level

igImportant: The monthly limit renews on the first of each Gregorian month

guides.igTipsSub: Golden rules we learned from thousands of investors' experiences

igTips.title: Diversify your investments
igTips.body: Don't put all your money in one project. Diversifying across different sectors greatly reduces risk.

igTips.title: Read before investing
igTips.body: Review the feasibility study, business plan and company record before any decision. Information is the key to a sound decision.

igTips.title: Think long term
igTips.body: Good projects need time to grow. Don't make decisions based on short-term fluctuations.

igTips.title: Monitor performance
igTips.body: Track funding ratios and project reports regularly to keep your decisions well-informed.

igTips.title: Understand the risks
igTips.body: Every investment carries risk. Only invest what you can afford to lose.

igTips.title: Be patient for the gems
igTips.body: The best investments come from patience. Don't sell because of a temporary price wobble.

support.a_f1: RailOS is an Iraqi digital investment platform that lets you buy and sell investment shares in verified projects across multiple sectors (agriculture, real estate, industry, trade) with full transparency and low commissions.
support.a_f2: Yes. We use advanced encryption (TLS 1.3 + AES-256) to protect your data. All transactions are documented, and projects undergo periodic auditing before being listed.
support.a_f3: You can reach us via: WhatsApp (+964 770 1234567), Email (railostrade@gmail.com), or by sending a support request directly from this page.
support.q_f3a: Is the platform licensed in Iraq?
support.a_f3a: Yes, RailOS is registered as an Iraqi digital-investment company and operates under local investment regulations. All listed projects are licensed by the competent authorities.
support.q_f3b: Do I need Iraqi citizenship to invest?
support.a_f3b: No, the platform is open to investors inside and outside Iraq. You only need a valid official ID (national ID or passport) to complete verification.
support.q_f3c: What's the difference between RailOS and a traditional stock exchange?
support.a_f3c: RailOS specializes in investing in real income-generating projects (farms, real estate, tech). A stock exchange deals with joint-stock company shares. RailOS is more transparent with higher returns but less instant liquidity.
support.a_f4:
To start easily:
1️⃣ Complete KYC verification at /kyc
2️⃣ Open the market page /market
3️⃣ Browse and compare projects
4️⃣ Pick a project that fits your goals
5️⃣ Tap 'Invest now' and set the number of shares
No minimum — you can start with a single share.
support.a_f5: There's no minimum — you can buy just one share. Share price ranges between 80,000 - 250,000 IQD depending on the project.
support.a_f6:
Profits are calculated based on:
• Your stake (number of shares × profit per share)
• Project period (month/quarter/year)
• Actual project performance

e.g.: a project distributing 5% quarterly, and you own 100 shares at 100,000 = 10M investment = ~500K IQD quarterly profit.

You can track all distributions in /investment.
support.q_f6a: When do I receive my profits?
support.a_f6a:
Depending on the project type:
• Monthly — every 30 days
• Quarterly — every 3 months
• Semi-annual — every 6 months
• Annual — once a year

They're transferred automatically to your wallet with a receipt notification.
support.q_f7: Can I sell my shares before the project ends?
support.a_f7:
Yes, via:
• The secondary market /exchange — post a sell listing and wait for a buyer
• Quick Sell — instant sale with a 15% discount

No time limits — you can sell anytime.
support.q_f7a: What's the difference between the primary and secondary market?
support.a_f7a:
Primary market (/market): buy new shares directly from projects.
Secondary market (/exchange): buy and sell shares between investors themselves — you may find better prices or rare shares.
support.q_f7b: What are the 'sectors' and which is best?
support.a_f7b:
We offer 6 sectors:
🌾 Agriculture — stability + regular distributions
🏢 Real estate — long growth + rents
🏭 Industry — medium growth + volatility
🏪 Trade — fast liquidity
💻 Tech — high growth + higher risk
🏥 Medical — long-term stable

Diversify across sectors to reduce risk.
support.a_f7c: If a project fails, all assets are liquidated and returns distributed by share ratio. This is rare — every project undergoes strict auditing before acceptance. Diversification is also advised to reduce the impact of any potential loss.
support.q_f8: How do I see my portfolio?
support.a_f8:
Go to /portfolio to see:
• All your shares + their current value
• Total profit/loss
• Full transaction log
• Remaining monthly limits
• Transferring shares between accounts
support.a_f9:
Each investor level has a monthly sell/buy limit:
• Basic → 10M IQD/month
• Advanced → 50M IQD/month
• Pro → 250M IQD/month

Joining a group contract increases the limit by 25%.
support.q_f10: How do I raise my level?
support.a_f10:
Upgrade is automatic based on your performance:
• To Advanced: 100 successful deals + completed KYC + 95%+ success rate
• To Pro: 500 deals + 98% success
• To Elite: 2000 deals + 99% success

Your progress shows in /profile/level.
support.q_f10a: Can I transfer shares to someone else?
support.a_f10a: Yes, via the transfer button on the portfolio page. Pick the recipient (must be KYC-verified) and the number of shares. The transfer is free and doesn't count against the monthly limits.
support.q_f10b: What's the difference between available and frozen shares?
support.a_f10b:
Available shares: you can sell or transfer them immediately.
Frozen shares: tied to an ongoing deal or an active listing — released automatically when the deal completes or is cancelled.
support.a_f11: A group contract = an investment partnership between 2-7 investors. The sum of their monthly limits is multiplied by 1.25 (25% bonus) as a group monthly limit. Useful for large investments exceeding your individual limit.
support.q_f11a: How do I create a group contract?
support.a_f11a:
1) Go to /contracts/create
2) Add partners by name and email
3) Set each partner's percentage
4) Review the terms and tap publish
5) The contract waits for all partners' approval before activation
support.q_f12: Can I withdraw from a contract?
support.a_f12:
• Before the contract activates: yes, with no fees
• After activation: needs all partners' approval + a 2% withdrawal fee
support.q_f12a: How are profits distributed in a group contract?
support.a_f12a: By each partner's percentage set in the contract. The system transfers the percentages automatically at every distribution — no manual intervention needed.
support.a_f13: KYC = Know Your Customer. The process of verifying your identity (ID + selfie) to ensure platform security and unlock all features. It usually takes 24-48 hours.
support.q_f14: What do I need for verification?
support.a_f14:
You only need:
1) A photo of a civil ID or passport (clear from both sides)
2) A selfie holding your ID

Everything is automatic via the app from /kyc.
support.a_f14a: Usually 24-48 business hours. During busy times it may reach 72 hours. You'll get a notification as soon as it's approved or rejected with the reason.
support.q_f14b: Why was the verification request rejected?
support.a_f14b:
Common rejection reasons:
• ID photo unclear (glare/shadow)
• The ID name doesn't match the registered name
• The selfie is unclear
• Exceeded the number of attempts (3 times)

You can reapply 24 hours later from /kyc.
support.q_f14c: Can I use the platform without verification?
support.a_f14c:
You can browse and view, but:
❌ You can't invest
❌ You can't buy/sell
❌ You can't create contracts

Verification is mandatory for any financial operation.
support.a_f15:
Fixed, transparent commissions:
• 2% on every buy/sell deal — paid by the buyer
• 0.25% on repeated listing ads (first is free)
• 5,000 units for a Quick Sell ad
• 2,500 units to create an auction

No hidden fees — all commissions are shown before confirmation.
support.a_f15a:
Commission = 2% × the total deal value

Example: buying 50 shares at 100,000 = 5M IQD
Commission = 5M × 2% = 100,000 IQD
Total to pay = 5,100,000 IQD

The rate is uniform — it doesn't change by level or project type.
support.q_f15b: Are there fees on profit deposits?
support.a_f15b: No, receiving profits is completely free. Distributions go directly to your wallet with no deduction from the platform.
support.a_f16:
Units used to pay ad fees and special features:
• 1,500 units → repeated listing ad
• 2,500 units → create an auction
• 5,000 units → Quick Sell ad

They're topped up by the admin via a request from the portfolio page.
support.q_f16a: How do I get fee units?
support.a_f16a:
1) Go to /portfolio → 'Fee units' tab
2) Tap 'Request top-up'
3) Set the amount
4) Pay to the displayed bank account
5) Upload the payment receipt — added within 6 hours.
support.q_f17: How do I protect my account?
support.a_f17:
Best security practices:
1) A strong password (8+ chars + symbols + numbers)
2) Don't share it with anyone — not even support
3) Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) from /settings
4) Sign out from public devices
5) Review the login log periodically
support.a_f17a:
Yes — multi-layered protection:
🔒 TLS 1.3 encryption for every connection
🔒 AES-256 encryption for stored data
🔒 Strict permissions (Row-Level Security)
🔒 Daily backups
🔒 24/7 suspicious-activity monitoring
support.q_f18: What if I forget my password?
support.a_f18:
1) Tap 'Forgot password' on the login page
2) Enter your email
3) We'll send a reset link within minutes
4) Open the link and choose a new password

The link is valid for one hour only.
support.a_f18a: No — every operation requires confirmation from your authenticated account. Even the admin can't transfer your shares without your approval. If you notice any suspicious activity, report it to support immediately.

healthcare.heroDesc: We believe health is a right for everyone. This program was born to bridge the gap between expensive treatment costs and the Iraqi citizen's means.
healthcare.s1Body: A healthcare program supporting patients in need among RailOS investors and the general public. It funds expensive treatments and provides affordable health insurance.
healthcare.s2Body: From 3 sources: (1) monthly insurance subscriptions, (2) direct member donations, (3) a share of deal fees (0.05%) allocated to the health fund.
healthcare.s3Body: A KYC-verified account + an official medical report from an accredited hospital + proof of financial need. Priority goes to urgent life-threatening cases.
healthcare.s5Body: Each request is reviewed by a specialized medical team within 5-7 business days. Reports are verified + the hospital is contacted + the financial situation is assessed.
healthcare.s6Body: Every donation is documented and tracked. Periodic reports are published monthly. Each case has a public page showing the amount raised and the donors list (with a name-hiding option).
healthcare.moreInfoDesc: Have a question? Contact us via technical support or visit the FAQ page.

orphans.heroDesc: We believe supporting an orphan today builds an aware, educated generation tomorrow. Our goal: 1,000 sponsored children by the end of 2027.
orphans.s1Body: A humanitarian program caring for children who lost one or both parents — providing educational, health and living support via individual sponsorship or general donations.
orphans.s2Title: How do we choose the children?
orphans.s2Body: We partner with accredited associations in all provinces. Each child undergoes a field visit + an interview with the foster family + a review of the financial/health/education situation.
orphans.s4Body: You receive monthly or quarterly reports including: the child's academic progress + health status + recent photos + messages from the child (when possible).
